svg.aria-label: Scatter chart of fiber versus calories per 100 grams for 432 foods
svg.text: Fiber vs calories in pre-run foods
432 USDA foods, per 100 g. 126 fit the pre-run rule; all of them sit at or below 3 g fiber per 100 kcal.
